parameters.query:
WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS channel,
        $3::TEXT AS external_conversation_id,
        NULLIF($4::TEXT, '') AS mobile,
        $5::TEXT AS direction,
        $6::TEXT AS sender_type,
        $7::TEXT AS message_type,
        NULLIF($8::TEXT, '') AS message_text,
        $9::JSONB AS message_payload,
        $10::TEXT AS language,
        LEAST(GREATEST($11::INTEGER, 1), 720) AS session_expiry_hours,
        LEAST(GREATEST($12::INTEGER, 1), 100) AS context_message_limit
),

clinic_context AS (
    SELECT
        clinic.id AS clinic_id,
        clinic.name AS clinic_name,
        request.*

    FROM request_data request

    INNER JOIN clinics clinic
        ON clinic.name = request.clinic_name
       AND clinic.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY clinic.id
    LIMIT 1
),

patient_context AS (
    SELECT
        patient.id AS patient_id,
        patient.full_name AS patient_name,
        patient.mobile

    FROM patients patient

    INNER JOIN clinic_context context
        ON context.clinic_id = patient.clinic_id
       AND context.mobile = patient.mobile

    LIMIT 1
),

upserted_session AS (
    INSERT INTO conversation_sessions (
        session_key,
        clinic_id,
        patient_id,
        channel,
        external_conversation_id,
        status,
        language,
        last_message_at,
        expires_at
    )

    SELECT
        MD5(
            context.clinic_id::TEXT
            || ':'
            || context.channel
            || ':'
            || context.external_conversation_id
        ),
        context.clinic_id,
        (
            SELECT patient_id
            FROM patient_context
        ),
        context.channel,
        context.external_conversation_id,
        'active',
        context.language,
        NOW(),
        NOW() + MAKE_INTERVAL(
            hours => context.session_expiry_hours
        )

    FROM clinic_context context

    ON CONFLICT (
        clinic_id,
        channel,
        external_conversation_id
    )
    DO UPDATE SET
        patient_id = COALESCE(
            conversation_sessions.patient_id,
            EXCLUDED.patient_id
        ),
        status = CASE
            WHEN conversation_sessions.status = 'closed'
                THEN 'active'
            ELSE conversation_sessions.status
        END,
        language = EXCLUDED.language,
        last_message_at = NOW(),
        expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at,
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING *
),

inserted_message AS (
    INSERT INTO conversation_messages (
        session_id,
        direction,
        sender_type,
        message_type,
        content_text,
        content_json
    )

    SELECT
        session.id,
        context.direction,
        context.sender_type,
        context.message_type,
        context.message_text,
        NULLIF(
            context.message_payload,
            '{}'::JSONB
        )

    FROM upserted_session session
    CROSS JOIN clinic_context context

    RETURNING *
),

recent_message_rows AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            message.id AS message_id,
            message.direction,
            message.sender_type,
            message.message_type,
            message.content_text,
            message.content_json,
            message.intent,
            message.intent_confidence,
            message.extracted_entities,
            message.risk_flags,
            message.tool_action,
            message.tool_result,
            message.created_at

        FROM conversation_messages message

        INNER JOIN upserted_session session
            ON session.id = message.session_id

        ORDER BY
            message.created_at DESC,
            message.id DESC

        LIMIT (
            SELECT context_message_limit
            FROM clinic_context
        )
    ) recent

    ORDER BY
        recent.created_at ASC,
        recent.message_id ASC
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN FALSE
        ELSE TRUE
    END AS success,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'clinic_not_found'
        ELSE 'conversation_message_stored'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM clinic_context
        )
            THEN 'کلینیک مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        ELSE 'پیام ثبت و زمینه مکالمه دریافت شد.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS session_id,

    (
        SELECT session_key
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS session_key,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_message
    ) AS message_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_id
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS patient_id,

    (
        SELECT patient_name
        FROM patient_context
    ) AS patient_name,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS session_status,

    (
        SELECT language
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS language,

    (
        SELECT last_intent
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS last_intent,

    (
        SELECT pending_action
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS pending_action,

    (
        SELECT collected_entities
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS collected_entities,

    (
        SELECT risk_flags
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS session_risk_flags,

    (
        SELECT context_summary
        FROM upserted_session
    ) AS context_summary,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT JSONB_AGG(
                JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
                    'message_id', message_id,
                    'direction', direction,
                    'sender_type', sender_type,
                    'message_type', message_type,
                    'content_text', content_text,
                    'content_json', content_json,
                    'intent', intent,
                    'intent_confidence', intent_confidence,
                    'extracted_entities', extracted_entities,
                    'risk_flags', risk_flags,
                    'tool_action', tool_action,
                    'tool_result', tool_result,
                    'created_at', created_at
                )
                ORDER BY created_at, message_id
            )
            FROM recent_message_rows
        ),
        '[]'::JSONB
    ) AS recent_messages,

    'analyze_message_with_ai'::TEXT AS next_action

FROM request_data request;

parameters.content:
## درگاه ثبت پیام و بازیابی حافظه

1. ابتدا Workflow شماره 49 را یک‌بار اجرا کن.

2. external_conversation_id شناسه گفت‌وگو در WhatsApp، وب‌چت، تلفن یا کانال دیگر است.

3. هر پیام در PostgreSQL ذخیره می‌شود و آخرین پیام‌های جلسه برای مدل زبانی برگردانده می‌شوند.

4. این Workflow هنوز مدل زبانی را اجرا نمی‌کند؛ خروجی آن ورودی Workflow شماره 51 است.
